executive_summary: Revise. The candidate digest and all 144 iteration-02 evidence-manifest entries reproduce exactly, and the iteration-01 Ivey and BoC source-label findings are otherwise remediated. However, both active CRA observable-proxy evidence_path fields still point to iteration-01 evidence whose CRAU26 row differs from the iteration-02 row used in the candidate. The pricing provenance therefore cannot reproduce the displayed current quote and the candidate is not safe for unconditional publication.

findings.issue: The active CRAU26 quote fields in the iteration-02 candidate are attributed to an iteration-01 evidence artifact. That path is stale for this frozen snapshot: the referenced iteration-01 row has a different last price, volume, bid size, ask size, net change, high, and number of trades than the iteration-02 row used to populate the candidate.
findings.evidence: candidate.json records iteration-02 CRAU26 values last 97.6000, bid 97.5950 x 49, ask 97.6000 x 107, volume 217, net change 0, high 97.6000, low 97.5900 and 7 trades, observed at 2026-09-15T03:15:24-04:00, but both evidence_path fields point to review/fed-boc/2026-09-15/iteration-01/evidence/cra.html. The iteration-01 frozen CRA row records last 97.5950, bid 97.5950 x 20, ask 97.6000 x 175, volume 197, net change -0.005, high 97.5950 and 6 trades. The iteration-02 handoff manifest correctly hashes evidence/cra.html at 95,425 bytes, but its field-level mapping omits these two candidate evidence_path fields. The iteration-02 CRA meta records HTTP 200 and completion at 2026-09-15T03:15:24-04:00, and the iteration-02 evidence contains the current row, so this is a cross-iteration attribution error rather than a missing-source problem.
findings.pnl_impact: A PM following either active evidence_path would reproduce an older CRA quote rather than the displayed overnight quote and liquidity snapshot. That can distort confidence in the BoC front-end proxy, especially volume, spread, and trade-count interpretation, and makes the frozen pricing block non-auditable for P&L decisions.
findings.instruction: Rebuild the whole candidate with both active CRA evidence_path fields pointing to the iteration-02 artifact review/fed-boc/2026-09-15/iteration-02/evidence/cra.html, add those fields to the handoff field-level remediation/evidence mapping, and reassert every CRA row field against that artifact. Recompute candidate.sha256 and candidate.sha256 file content, then submit a fresh independent PM review; do not publish this candidate.
